description: Dynamic power management (de-probabilised, game cast on an MDP). Mapping: requests arrive (arr=input(env), queue++); the power manager serves or sleeps (cmd=input(pm), queue-- if serving); safety = queue stays within capacity. The PM reads the arrival before deciding, so serving every round keeps the queue at 0/1 <= cap -> expected TRUE. cap is arbitrary (input(env), not fixed). CAVEATS: the coalition/adversary split is IMPOSED on a single-agent MDP (not a real game); the winning strategy is trivial (serve every round); the 1-for-1 arrival/service dynamics keep the queue <= 1 so the cap threshold is loose. Captures only the queue-safety core, not the energy reward.
